question: Will the price of eggs decrease by more than 2% in the next month?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BLS Average Price Data monthly value for Eggs, grade A, large, per doz. (series APU0000708111), U.S. city average, for October 2026 — as released by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics strictly after 2026-10-15T14:43:07Z and at or before 2026-11-15T16:00:00Z — is more than 2% lower than the September 2026 value for the same series.
- "No": Wins if the BLS Average Price Data monthly value for Eggs, grade A, large, per doz. (series APU0000708111), U.S. city average, for October 2026 — as released by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics strictly after 2026-10-15T14:43:07Z and at or before 2026-11-15T16:00:00Z — is not more than 2% lower than the September 2026 value for the same series (i.e., the decrease is 2% or less, or the price is unchanged or higher).

Clarifications:
- The percentage change is calculated as: (October 2026 value − September 2026 value) / September 2026 value × 100. A decrease of more than 2% means this figure is less than −2.00%.
- The September 2026 BLS average price figure serves as the baseline; it is the most recent complete monthly value published before the window opened on 2026-10-15T14:43:07Z.
- If the BLS October 2026 figure is not released at or before 2026-11-15T16:00:00Z, the market is unresolvable.
